message.content: {"summary":"You delivered a strong, well-evidenced GBR monitoring mission with a clear purpose, SSO design, and good STK support. Your Introduction and Main Body are accomplished, and Conclusion is specific. Presentation is adequate - structure is clear but figure labelling and referencing limited your score.","criteria":{"C1":"You did well in Introduction: primary mission of reef monitoring with fluid lensing, need with 30% loss, single spacecraft for simplicity, and users CSIRO/BOM. To reach 10/10, add more detailed literature and deeper discussion of why one spacecraft meets temporal resolution.","C2":"Strong work in Mission Design: you justified Vega E from Guiana Space Centre with alternatives, defined 600 km SSO with i=97.79°, a=6971 km in your COEs table, and used STK Images 4-5 and access stats with Tasmania Mount Pleasant station. For 10/10, add launch performance calculations and complete maneuver analysis.","C3":"Your Conclusion effectively synthesizes your evidence: Vega E fallback to Vega C, polar SSO for illumination, Mt Pleasant for long contacts, and deorbit with drag sail. To strengthen to 9-10, expand why this meets the GBR need and note limitations or future work.","C4":"Report structure is logical with Executive Summary and TOC and readable writing. To move from Adequate to Accomplished, ensure all figures/tables are consistently numbered and labelled (e.g., STK 3D views, access table), and replace Wikipedia in Bibliography with primary sources with consistent citation format."},"next_steps":["Fix reference quality: replace Wikipedia link in Bibliography with peer-reviewed or agency sources and ensure in-text citations match reference list.","Standardize all figures/tables with consecutive numbers, titles, and source notes - especially Images 1-5 and access report - and check Executive Summary overview is concise.","For future designs, add quantitative launch performance and clearer orbital element definitions (use ω and ν for circular orbit) to fully support vehicle and orbit choices."]}
